task.title: To create a Display Action
task.shortdesc: When data has been retrieved from the environment, it is placed in Excel memory, waiting

step.cmd: Click the arrow under Actions and select Display.
Enter Display Opportunities into the Action Name field.
Choose Main from the Display Map list.

result.p: When data has been retrieved from the environment, it is placed in Excel memory, waiting to be placed into the specific worksheet based on a Display Map. You may want to display different maps at different times when your App is in use, so a Display Action lets you decide which map to use and when to use it.
